title: Masu Sauraro Daga Gaibi
intro: Bayan labulen duniyar da ake gani, wani taro mai ɓoye ya taru a cikin duhu, wanda aka jawo shi zuwa ga wani sauti da ya saba wa duk abin da suka sani. Sun yi ta yawo tsawon shekaru ba tare da jagora na gaskiya ba, har sai da wata murya ta ratsa cikin shirun duniyarsu da ba a gani ta kuma tayar da wani abu a cikinta. A daren yau, an gayyace ku ku wuce inuwa ku gano asalin wannan rukunin mai ban mamaki, wanda haɗuwa da kalmomin allahntaka ta kai su ga mutanensu a matsayin masu gargaɗi game da gaskiya da ba za a iya riƙe ta ba.
clues: Mu halittu ne na da, waɗanda suka wanzu tun kafin al'ummomi da yawa da ka karanta game da su, duk da haka ba a cika ambatonmu a cikin tatsuniyoyi na ɗan adam ba.
Yanayinmu ba kamar naka ba ne, an saka shi daga abubuwan da ba a gani ba, kuma muna da iko da ke ƙalubalantar abin da ba na yau da kullun ba.
Tsawon shekaru, mun yi ta yawo ba tare da jagora na gaskiya ba, har sai da wata ƙara ta isa gare mu wadda ta motsa wani abu a cikinmu.
Mun ji wani irin karatu kamar babu abin da muka taɓa ji, kalmomi masu nauyi fiye da kowace magana.
Mun matsa kusa a ɓoye, muna umurtar namu da su yi shiru, kuma lokacin da ayoyin suka ƙare, ba za mu iya tsayawa cak ba.
Mun koma ga mutanenmu muka ce: 'Ya ku mutanenmu, mun ji wani littafi da aka saukar bayan Musa, yana tabbatar da abin da ke gabansa, yana shiryarwa zuwa ga gaskiya.'

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Hawariyyun (Almajiran Isa)
Aljani wanda ya yi imani bayan ya ji Alqur'ani
Ma'abota Kogo
Mala'ikun sama mafi ƙasƙanci
Mutanen Fir'auna waɗanda suka bi tafarkinsa
identity.answer: Aljani wanda ya yi imani bayan ya ji Alqur'ani

trial.label: Gwaji / Taro
options: An kore mu saboda ƙin yin sujada a gaban wani sabon halitta
An rufe mu a cikin kogo tsawon shekaru ɗari uku da tara
An umarce mu da mu ketare teku da ta raba a gabanmu
An tura mu zuwa ƙasar sihiri don koyon sihiri
Mun saurari wani karatu a ɓoye kuma aka canza mu ta hanyarsa
trial.answer: Mun saurari wani karatu a ɓoye kuma aka canza mu ta hanyarsa

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Ɗan maraƙi na zinariya da aka ƙera daga kayan adon mutane
Kogo wanda barcinsa ya daɗe tsawon tsararraki da yawa
Mala'iku biyu a Babila waɗanda suka koyar da ilimin da aka haramta

location.answer: Littafi da aka saukar bayan Musa, yana tabbatar da Attaura

options: An la'ance mu har zuwa Ranar Sakamako

outcome.answer: Mun koma ga mutanenmu a matsayin masu gargaɗi, muna shelar imani

arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
verse: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. (72:2)
